fields.description: Our RSA private key (PEM, generated via `openssl genrsa -out privatekey.pem 2048`). Used to decrypt the incoming session_key.
fields.label: Client Private Key

fields.description: Required only if the uploaded private key is passphrase-protected.
fields.label: Client Private Key Password

fields.description: SBI's RSA public key (PEM). Used to wrap our AES session key in responses and to verify incoming hash_digest signatures.
fields.label: SBI Public Key

fields.description: Credentials SBI uses to call our authenticate endpoint.
fields.label: SBI Username

fields.description: When enabled, the authenticate endpoint decrypts incoming requests and encrypts responses (production). Disable for development/UAT to use plain JSON.
fields.label: Enable Encryption

fields.description: Secret used to sign the bearer token issued by authenticate. Auto-generated on install if left empty.
fields.label: JWT Secret

fields.description: Exactly 6 alphanumeric characters. Used as the first part of every generated Collection VAN (VAN = prefix + customer identifier).
fields.label: VAN Prefix

fields.description: Maximum total length of a generated VAN. The server rejects any VAN that exceeds this length.
fields.label: VAN Max Length

fields.description: The SBI Collection document marks dealer validation as Optional. Enable only if opted in.
fields.label: Enable Dealer Validation

fields.description: Company under which future Payment Entries will be created.
fields.label: Default Company

fields.description: Bank Account where SBI collections land. Its ledger account is used as paid_to on Payment Entries created by the Transaction Post API.
fields.label: Collection Bank Account

fields.description: Disable only in a UAT environment for testing.
fields.label: SSL Verify
